desc:
Welcome to INDOPOLY! Are you ready to build a property empire and become the most influential tycoon in all of Indonesia? 🎲

Main Features:
💰 Local Economy: Collect income from renting your properties and build dominance across the game board. 
🎲 Exciting and Strategic Gameplay: Roll dice, determine the best moves, make important decisions, and avoid the Prison (Lapas) that can hinder your progress! 
🎮 Multiplayer Mode (Mabar): Play with your friends, compete directly, and prove who is the best at managing assets and strategies. 
⭐ Like & Favorite this game to support our latest updates! 

Prepare yourself for an exciting competition, full of tactics and surprises at every turn. It's time to prove your skills in mastering the world of property in INDOPOLY!

🎁 Use Redeem Code: INDOPOLYv2, WELCOMEBACK

#Indopoly #BoardGame #Strategy #Simulator #Multiplayer
